paths.title: B.Tech Engineering Path
paths.why_it_fits: Structured academic environment providing foundational theory; compare total cost per institution against the student's stated budget preference.
tradeoffs: Curriculum may delay specialized ML topics to later years.
Requires juggling heavy engineering coursework with self-directed project development.

milestones.timeframe: Until JEE preparation ends; date not stated in the profile
milestones.focus: Maintain basic coding practice within the 5-10 hours/week limit.
Transition to intensive software engineering foundations.

projects: Relational database design for a local dataset

milestones.focus: Classical ML algorithms and evaluation metrics.
projects: Predictive model for classification of public survey data
Contributed code to an internship project involving data pipelines
End-to-end ML service with automated unit tests and containerized deployment

internship_strategy.readiness: Student can clean raw data, train a scikit-learn model, and demonstrate performance with precision and recall metrics.
preparation: Build a portfolio of three distinct, documented ML experiments on GitHub
internship_strategy.application_stage: Begin applying once the student can independently explain the bias-variance tradeoff and demonstrate a project using Scikit-Learn; this may occur around Year 2 depending on progress.

paths.title: B.Sc Mathematics Track
paths.why_it_fits: Stronger mathematical focus allowing faster progression into theoretical ML; compare total cost per institution against the student's stated budget preference.
tradeoffs: Lacks integrated software engineering training found in B.Tech.
Requires significant independent effort to learn industry-standard production tools.

milestones.timeframe: Until JEE preparation ends; date not stated in the profile

milestones.focus: Bridge mathematical concepts to data handling.
Deep mathematical understanding of machine learning foundations.
projects: Implemented linear regression from scratch using matrix algebra
Analysis of high-dimensional datasets using unsupervised learning techniques

milestones.focus: Building robust data systems in internships.
projects: Refactored internship code for performance and reproducibility

milestones.focus: System design and production ML pipelines.
projects: Comprehensive portfolio of production-ready models with automated evaluation workflows

internship_strategy.readiness: Student can implement classic ML algorithms from scratch using only numerical libraries and evaluate them against library implementations.
preparation: Write detailed documentation for mathematical implementations of ML algorithms
internship_strategy.application_stage: Begin applying once the student can demonstrate custom implementation of core ML algorithms and a successful data project; this may occur around Year 2 depending on progress.
